ms.report:
Outputs:
Support for crypto, stablecoin and fiat / credit card payments
For this output we created an embed wallet system and used Polar payment to make an in house solution, dealing with token prices and matching properly with the cost of creating records is done via an api that constantly returns how much records should cost BASED on an asset value. In our example we used the preview network and a self minted asset to simulate tUSDM, results can be found in the evidence of completion videos.

Simplified onboarding with user flows that do not require wallet setup.
Our video example was made to explain how embed wallets are created on user sign up using oAuth, email or github, they receive 2 wallet addresses (preview and mainnet) and a seed which we can HIDE or not from the user, based on the flow and user experience we want to create. Then we, if we are managing the wallet, or the user, can fill this wallet with required assets which we verify via their policy id + name hex. Wallets in this example are managed by the user and our server uses a zero knowledge system, where WE don’t have access to the user seed and can’t sign on the user behalf. This system can be easily changed to make an easy-to-use system where the user doesn't have to deal with wallets, filling it up, passwords or seeds.

Smooth user creation and login for both crypto and non-crypto audience (e.g via social logins such as Google).
We moved away from connecting wallets and all authentication is handled via oauth, email or github access.

Event cascading and trace preservation: ability to connect and reference existing trace records.
Users can now create new records and reference old or new records, providing updates to its content. The record page displays the user reference and old versions of it. It is possible for the user to configure the record to enable anyone to reference it (as a fork) or to enable anyone in the user workspace/organization to reference it.

ms.report:
Output:
Use-case Agnostic: Enable flexible, sector-agnostic customization of trace events.
Trace It system enables users to create any type of events, not just events for important sectors and companies, but community and day to day events anyone may want to record.

Community Templates: Build a collaborative ecosystem of reusable templates for different use cases for the community to leverage (reducing time to build and customize from scratch).
Trace It now supports 2 modules which are workspace/organization templates, and community template explorer. The workspace templates are templates the user created (public or private) and favorite templates from the community. 

Personal Template Module for each user (enables each user to create and save custom templates which are re-usable to ensure ease of use).
Inside the workspace/organization a single user or team members can now manage, save, create or delete templates, which could be private templates or public templates.

Import / Export options for sharing templates.
With the template explorer it is very easy to find templates from the community, but it is also possible to “share” as each template creates its own link slug, you can use it to share with someone who may need or have a similar use-case, the template explorer is outside of the workspace/organization scope and as long as you’re authenticated you see then.
